national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves Continuation of PM Mudra Yojana and Stand-Up India Scheme
bullets: The Union Cabinet approved the continuation of the Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units under the Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) up to 31st March 2031 with an outlay of ₹5,000 crore.
Since the launch of the PM Mudra Scheme, over 60.36 crore loans amounting to ₹43.34 lakh crore have been sanctioned by lending institutions.
The Cabinet also approved the continuation of the Stand-Up India Scheme up to 31st March 2031, aiming to support an additional 2.5 lakh Women, SC, and ST entrepreneurs with a corpus of ₹4,111 crore.
Additionally, the extension of the Aqua Line Metro Rail Corridor from Noida Sector-51 to Greater Noida Sector-04 (8.5 km, 5 stations) was approved.

national_news.title: Russia and Ukraine Agree in Principle on Major Prisoner-of-War Exchange
bullets: Russia and Ukraine agreed in principle to a major prisoner-of-war exchange following US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi led by US special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner.
The agreement is anticipated to result in the largest humanitarian release of prisoners since the conflict began nearly five years ago.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy insisted on the active participation of European countries in future security negotiations, while differences remain over territory, security guarantees, and NATO.

national_news.title: President Droupadi Murmu Confers Swachh Survekshan Awards 2025-26
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu conferred the Swachh Survekshan Awards 2025-26 in New Delhi, celebrating the cleanest cities under the Swachh Bharat Mission-Urban.
The 10th edition of Swachh Survekshan was themed ‘Swachhata Ki Nayi Pehel- Badhayein Haath, Karein Safai Saath’ and evaluated urban local bodies across 43 indicators spanning 10 key assessment areas.
The survey has expanded significantly from evaluating 73 Urban Local Bodies in 2016 to over 4,000 cities in its latest edition.

national_news.title: Government Invites Fresh Applications Under PLI Scheme for Medical Devices (PLI-MD 2.0)
bullets: The Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers invited fresh applications under the Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Promoting Domestic Manufacturing of Medical Devices (PLI-MD 2.0).
The scheme has been extended up to 2035-36 with a total financial outlay of around ₹2,700 crore.
Key revisions include the removal of minimum sales thresholds, reduced minimum investment requirements, and three years given to establish facilities across four target segments.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Develop ₹1.21 Lakh Crore Hajipur-Gaya Industrial Corridor and 5-District Defence Corridor
bullets: The Bihar government announced the development of an industrial corridor spanning 1,650 acres between Hajipur and Gaya, starting at Rajapakar in Vaishali, with an estimated investment proposal of ₹1.21 lakh crore.

A dedicated Defence Corridor will be established across five districts: Munger, Kaimur, Jamui, Banka, and Arwal to manufacture weapons including fighter jet parts, drones, artillery guns, and small arms.

The state currently operates an Ordnance Factory in Nalanda producing the Bi-Modular Charge System (BMCS) for artillery, while Munger retains its historical gun manufacturing identity dating back to 1760.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Cabinet Hikes DA/DR and Approves Startup & Fellowship Schemes for Female Students
bullets: The Bihar Cabinet approved a 3% increase in Dearness Allowance (DA) and Dearness Relief (DR) under the 7th Pay Commission (from 60% to 63%), alongside hikes for 6th and 5th Pay Commission structures effective July 1, 2026.
Approved the 'Bihar Ki Beti Startup Challenge Scheme' with an outlay of ₹88.20 crore (2026-30) to foster entrepreneurship among up to 2,100 female college students.

Sanctioned the 'Mukhyamantri Balika PhD Fellowship Scheme' to encourage women's participation in higher research, and extended the Modified Assured Career Progression (MACP) Scheme to regular urban local body employees.

bihar_news.title: Patna Municipal Corporation Lists ₹200-Crore Municipal Bonds on NSE
bullets: Patna Municipal Corporation (PMC) officially listed its ₹200-crore municipal bond on the National Stock Exchange (NSE), becoming the first civic body in Bihar to access market-based urban financing.
The state announced plans to expand Patna's Marine Drive from 26 km to 126 km with a proposed investment of ₹30,000 crore under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model.
The government highlighted urban development plans including 12 greenfield satellite townships like Pataliputra Township and financial support of up to ₹98,000 for 3-kW rooftop solar installations.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Launches Ganga Water Metro Service in Patna
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister launched a catamaran water metro service on the Ganga river operating between Digha Ghat and Gandhi Ghat in Patna, with plans for extension to Kangan Ghat.
The service utilizes a 50-seater hybrid electric-powered vessel designed to reduce pollution and provide an alternative transit route to the congested Ashok Rajpath.
The state tourism department initiative sets the single adult fare at ₹50, offering fast and shore charging facilities at the terminal ghats.
